cards.title: Men and women in admissions

headline.caption: of colleges admit women at a notably higher rate than men

cards.sentence: In fall 2004, 13% of colleges admitted men at a rate 3 or more points higher than women; in fall 2024, 6% did, while 48% favored women by as much.

series.name: Women admitted at a higher rate
Men admitted at a higher rate

cards.title: Test-optional went mainstream

headline.caption: of colleges still require the SAT or ACT

cards.sentence: In fall 2019, 66% of colleges required the SAT or ACT; in fall 2024, 5% did, while the median college's SAT submission share fell from 63% to 15%.

series.name: Share of colleges requiring the SAT or ACT

cards.title: Shrinking colleges

headline.caption: of colleges have at least 10% fewer undergraduates than ten years ago

cards.sentence: Across 1,537 colleges, 51% have at least 10% fewer undergraduates than in fall 2014, while 23% grew that much; the median college's undergraduate count fell 11%.

series.name: Smaller than at the window's start

cards.title: The price gap, by who is discounting

headline.caption: change in what students pay on average, after inflation

cards.sentence: At the median college, full price fell 1% after inflation over 10 years, while what students actually paid fell 12%, and the discount off the sticker price grew.

cards.title: Public colleges and students from other states

headline.caption: median public college's out-of-state share of first-years

cards.sentence: The median public college's out-of-state share rose from 11% in fall 2014 to 13% in fall 2024, and the share of publics that are 30%+ out-of-state rose from 17% to 22%.

cards.title: The Pell graduation gap

headline.caption: point gap between Pell recipients and students with neither, at the median college

cards.sentence: At the median college, Pell recipients from the class entering fall 2010 graduated within six years 9 points less often than students with neither a Pell Grant nor a subsidized loan; for the class entering fall 2018 the gap was 11 points.
